messages.subject: margins of control widgets
parts:
I like to know how we can control margins of control widgets, i.e., padding around a label element or numeric value or drop down list of a control widget. I need this so that I can have multiple control widgets in several rows next to each other, which look like as a group. Assigning ‘label’ as NULL solved the problem to an extent, but I want to reduce the space further between widgets.

The following code generates three control widgets, and I want to reduce the space between between first and second, and second and third widgets. Greatly appreciate your help.

library(shiny)
plotvars <- c("Cars","Book stores","Libraries")
ui <- fluidPage(
   sidebarPanel(
      selectInput('plot1xvar', 'Plot 1 - X, Y, Z Variables', plotvars,plotvars[1]),
      selectInput('plot1yvar', label=NULL, plotvars,plotvars[2]),
      selectInput('plot1zvar', label=NULL, plotvars,plotvars[3])
   ),
   mainPanel()
)
server <- shinyServer(function(input,output){})
shinyApp(ui, server)
